title: Adding tranformData breaks the emptytemplate

comments.body:
As pointed, `transformData` should be an object with `item` and `empty` keys. In previous versions of instantsearch, we allowed passing a function directly, as a shortcut for `transformData.item` but this will be deprecated.

Maybe we have an example/tutorial/documentation somewhere with the old behavior. If that's the case, please give us the url so we can fix this :)

I had one here: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/35437004/algolia-initial-search-parameters-instantsearch-js/35440096#35440096

Now fixed
